source: Strings recorded per rule for the Azure and Google Cloud candidate rules (src/analysis/candidate-rules-focus.js). A rule matches a row by ServiceName (service) and ChargeDescription (the row model usageType). "match" entries are strings copied from the source named in the rule, "miss" entries are nearby real strings, or a real description under a different service where noted, that the rule must not match. Azure strings come from the official FOCUS 1.0 sample data (CC BY 4.0, see test/fixtures/focus/official-sample.NOTICE.md); that sample has only two Google Cloud rows, so most Google Cloud strings come from Google's own documentation, fetched 2026-11-12.
notCovered: Azure FOCUS exports carry x_SkuMeterCategory, x_SkuMeterSubcategory, x_SkuMeterName, x_SkuDescription and x_ResourceType (Microsoft FOCUS cost export documentation), but the sample data has none of these columns, so no rule matches on them. A FOCUS row cannot say whether a disk or address is attached, so none of these rules is evidence of an idle resource except the Cloud SQL idle address, which Google names in the SKU.

dropped.azure-nat-gateway: No NAT Gateway description in the Azure sample data.
dropped.azure-old-disk-tiers-unattached: Azure billing does not say a managed disk is unattached; only the disk tier is visible.
dropped.azure-premium-ssd-v2 / ultra disk: No such description in the sample data.
dropped.azure-bandwidth-other: Only the inter-region and routing-preference transfer lines were seen.
dropped.gcp-pd-ssd: "SSD backed PD Capacity" was not found in any sample row or Google page fetched. "Balanced PD Capacity" was seen but is the default disk type, not a signal.
dropped.gcp-external-ip-in-use: The SKU description of an in-use external IP address was not found in the sample data or the Google pages fetched.
dropped.gcp-cloud-logging-ingestion: The SKU description for log ingestion was not found. Google's pricing page describes the charge in prose only.
dropped.gcp-network-egress: No current internet or inter-region egress description was found; the legacy list has only Cloud Storage and Cloud SQL era names.
dropped.gcp-older-machine-families: Only N1 had a description in a Google page; other families were not found.
